record_scope_reconstruction: Mexico-side interruption of road cargo destined for Belize through the Santa Elena northern border. Free Zone shopping and passenger movement are not a whole-border closure. Mexican customs office and bridge used by the affected consignments remain unlocated.

source_checks.finding: March 23 original reports no inbound goods at the northern border, with produce held on the Mexican side; cartel attribution remains the report’s claim.
March 26 original reports restoration March 24 and CFZ management clarification that its own operations were uninterrupted; Santa Elena and CFZ are not interchangeable closure footprints.
Amandala reports suspension March 18–24 and ambassador uncertainty about attribution. This supports the cargo corridor, not a particular customs lane.
Indexed original explicitly identifies Santa Elena cargo resumption and quotes the ambassador describing road consignments held at the border.
Primary customs description identifies the Northern Border Station as Santa Elena, Corozal, and its cargo-clearance role.

Fresh original OSM node is explicitly named Belize Immigration, version 10 dated 2020-07-15. It locates the Belize end of the Santa Elena/Subteniente López route, not the Mexican cargo processing office or old/new bridge choice.
